kind: analyze (spin splitting + magnetism parsed from four completed QE runs; six graded fields after the 2026-09-03 expert-review reduction)
provenance: values from 3_reproduction/L1/result.json (leaf L1, reproduced 2026-07-09). Splitting quantities recomputed from auditor/extracted/bands_prim.csv, which was extracted from the primitive band run; the CSV E_up column is the first spin channel the outputs print. Sign convention: E(first spin channel) - E(second spin channel).

gap_eV.rule: within 10% relative (band 0.6731-0.8227). Path-restricted gap of the primitive band run.

mn_lsm_muB.rule: magnitude within 10% relative (band 4.042-4.940). Site-projected local moment of any Mn in the supercell scf run; all sites equal.

amss_valence_max_eV.rule: within 10% relative (band 0.7974-0.9746). Max magnitude splitting over all valence bands on L-Gamma-L'.

split_mean_LG_eV.rule: signed, within 10% relative (band 0.2808-0.3432). Mean signed splitting of the highest valence band on L-to-Gamma.

split_mean_GLp_eV.rule: signed, within 10% relative (band -0.3432 to -0.2808). Mean signed splitting on Gamma-to-L'; opposite sign to the L-to-Gamma mean is the altermagnetic signature.

sc_vbm_at_gamma.rule: exact boolean true. The primitive VBM at A folds onto the supercell zone center.

score: 1 only if every field passes its rule; any single failure scores 0
